findings.finding: Set equations: a+A=2(b+B), aA=4bB, a+A-5=b+B+5, a(A-5)=b(B+5). Search integers a,b≥1, A≥5, B≥0. Unique solution a=10,b=5,A=10,B=5 → product=10·5=50.

Key: From sums: a+A=2(b+B) and a+A−(b+B)=10 ⇒ b+B=10, a+A=20. Let a=20−A, b=10−B. Use product eqns: aA=4bB and a(A−5)=b(B+5). Brute‑force A∈[5,19], B∈[0,9] → only (a,b,A,B)=(10,5,10,5). Thus ages product=10·5=50.
